tokens.description: Turn a token JSON file into a CSS or SCSS file, with optional TypeScript mode lists and the modes index.

docs-data.description: Write the docs data of a project (component anatomy and meta, or the options and mode axes of a theme) as JSON.

api-docs-angular.description: Extract the API of every Angular entry point of a package from its TSDoc into ApiDoc JSON.

api-docs-react.description: Extract the API of every React entry point of a package from its TSDoc, through the TypeScript checker, into ApiDoc JSON.

api-docs-vue.description: Extract the API of every Vue entry point of a package from its TSDoc, through vue-component-meta, into ApiDoc JSON.

api-docs-ts.description: Extract the API of every module of a framework-free package (cdk, utils) from its TSDoc, through the TypeScript checker, into ApiDoc JSON with a function model.

api-parity.description: Compare the Angular, React and Vue ApiDoc files by semantic id.
